A '''steel axe''' is the [[Steel equipment|steel]] [[Tools#Axe|axe]], made by smithing an [[Iron Axe|iron axe]] with [[Steel Alloy|steel alloy]]. It mines at speed 8 and has 3000 durability.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/smithing/steel_axe.json}}</ref>

== Obtaining ==

=== Smithing ===
{{Recipes}}

The upgrade uses no template: the template slot of the [[smithing table]] is left empty.

Enchantments already on the base item are kept. Where the base and the new item share an enchantment, the higher level is used.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/function/mechanics/intrinsic_enchants/process_intrinsic_enchants.mcfunction}}</ref>

=== Loot ===
{{Sources}}

The loot table <code>matcha:equipment/steel/axe</code> gives the item exactly as crafted; it is used by <code>/loot</code> and by the [[Updating items|item update system]].

== Usage ==

=== Mining ===

It mines axe blocks at speed 8.

The pack adds beds, candles, cactus and honeycomb blocks to the blocks axes mine quickly.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/tags/block/mineable/axe.json}}</ref>

=== Combat ===

It deals 10 damage with an attack speed of 0.7, and adds 2 knockback to each hit.

=== Repairing ===

It is repaired in an [[anvil]] with [[Iron Ingot|iron ingots]]. Matcha Flavoured removes the repair cost limit, so it can be repaired indefinitely; see [[Repairing]].
